verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since AnythingLLM is an AI assistant with agent features. However, nothing in the pack shows it supervising or embedding coding agents that clone repos, edit files, or run tests. Custom agent skills, agent flows, and MCP compatibility are generic building blocks or adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, the assistant can supervise or embed real coding agents so it does repo work — cloning, editing, testing — not just snippets in chat
